context: Routing a plain migration ask ('migrate this page to EDS <url>') to the keep-design flow after the persona answers 'keep the design'. One session; each item judged pass/fail and weighted by max_score. Runs 2–4 in task.md are documented for a future multi-step runner and are not scored.

checklist.name: flow_named_first
checklist.description: The first response to every prompt names the chosen flow (redesign / replica) or, presents the two flows and asks the one keep-vs-redesign question. For keep-design phrases it also states that replica needs no prepare-migration step.

checklist.name: plain_ask_asks_once
checklist.description: exactly one question (keep vs redesign) is asked before any sub-skill loads, crawl runs or file is written. No second question, no default taken silently in an interactive session.

checklist.name: flow_recorded_in_state
checklist.description: stardust/state.json carries flow (replica for prompts 1-3 after the answer, redesign for prompt 4), flowChosenAt (ISO timestamp) and flowSource (question for prompt 1, user-phrase for 2-4), placed after direction and before pages.

checklist.name: replica_invoked_for_keep_design
checklist.description: After the persona answers "keep the design": the replica skill is the sub-skill invoked. prepare-migration is never loaded or read in these sessions.

checklist.name: migrate_never_first
checklist.description: In no session is the migrate skill the first sub-skill invoked on the fresh project; a migrate-first attempt would be refused by its flow guard and handed back to the master routing.

checklist.name: no_parallel_pipeline
checklist.description: The agent authors no crawler, importer or compiler of its own in any session; any replacement of a skill phase is recorded as a named deviation in stardust/direction.md.
